pins: Worker timing the replicas and enc_cron rely on: ingest poll, region export poll/idle, wake semantics, websocket status poll

input.question: region worker poll ms (zips pending, lock held, or lock busy)
region worker idle ms (nothing to do)

cases.expected: conflated signal; cuts a poll or idle wait short; called after ingest completes, chart delete and POST /v1/regions
one zip per lock cycle: acquire lock, clear ingest/, rename save/<zip> to ingest/<uuid>/<zip>
